name: Red Hat Certified Architect
name_ja: Red Hat認定アーキテクト

logistics.format: Aggregate credential earned by passing 5 additional Red Hat hands-on certification exams beyond the prerequisite base credential

formal: Earn one base credential: RHCE, Red Hat Certified Enterprise Microservices Developer (RHCEMD), or Red Hat Certified Cloud-native Developer (RHCCD)
Pass 5 additional Red Hat certifications from sysadmin or developer paths

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 3. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded base credential plus five additional practical exams support expert infrastructure breadth at five years, reinforced by Japanese availability; aggregate architecture standing does not imply dedicated security expertise.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Five additional hands-on certifications beyond a base credential demonstrate substantial breadth and depth for expert platform responsibility. General infrastructure focus and vendor dependence limit cybersecurity conclusions, while aggregate exams provide stronger evidence than the title alone.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded five additional hands-on exams beyond a base credential demonstrate substantial infrastructure breadth and depth. That accumulated practical evidence supports expert platform work, while it should not be read as dedicated cybersecurity expertise.
